The estate has 18 ha (11 Cabernet Franc, 7 Chenin Blanc) and averages 62,000 bottles; 2024 gave 48,000 after May hail. Organic since 2019; biodynamic certification possible from 2026. Exports are 41%, mainly Belgium and Japan, whose importer requires sulphites under 60 mg/l.

Key rules: no irrigation on western plots; harvest decided by three mornings of sugar/acidity readings; tanks above 28°C cooled within four hours. Controllers are calibrated pre-harvest; tank 4 has a second probe; label proofs need two signatures.

Open: lighter bottles (awaiting importer approval, no cost comparison) and whether to replant the 54-year-old eastern parcel after 2027.

Handover summary: 18 ha (11 Cabernet Franc, 7 Chenin Blanc); averages 62,000 bottles, 2024 gave 48,000 after May hail. Organic since 2019; biodynamic certification possible from 2026. Exports 41%, mainly Belgium and Japan, whose importer requires sulphites under 60 mg/l. No irrigation on western plots; harvest decided by three mornings of sugar/acidity readings; tanks above 28°C cooled within four hours. Controllers calibrated pre-harvest; tank 4 has a second probe; label proofs need two signatures.

Gaps: E07 (two failures) is not covered. E08 (2022 tank 4 controller drift, bulk loss) is missing. E10 (2023 label error, recall) is missing. E14 (lighter bottles) and E15 (eastern parcel replanting) are open items.
